verdict.rationale: Turso's docs say every token can be restricted by database, permission level, and expiration. Fine-grained permissions add table- and action-level control. The Platform API is explicitly pitched for provisioning a database per AI agent that you create, token-scope, and tear down programmatically, with JWKS-based token issuance as an alternative. Missing for 10: evidence that the account-level Platform API tokens (as opposed to database access tokens) can be scoped to least privilege, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the scoping in practice.
